description: This file defines a React hook 'useLinksService' that encapsulates CRUD operations, analytics, and click tracking for link management via Supabase. It interacts with a 'links' table in the database and utilizes other hooks for authentication context.

methods.name: waitForSession(timeoutMs = 5000)
methods.description: Waits until the user session is loaded or timeout occurs.

methods.name: listByUser
methods.description: Retrieves a list of links for the current user with optional filtering, sorting, and pagination.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Creates a new link entry for the authenticated user.

methods.name: update
methods.description: Updates an existing link owned by the current user.

methods.name: remove
methods.description: Deletes a link owned by the current user.

methods.name: incrementClicks
methods.description: Increments the click count for a specific link, using RPC if available, otherwise manual fallback.

methods.name: analytics
methods.description: Provides total number of links and total clicks for the current user.
